sources.name: Yu Zen
sources.quote: To be honest, I don't know much about the changing demographics in West Oakland. I've been focused on my own neighborhood, Rockridge, and my family. I've been dealing with my own recovery and getting back to my routine after my accident. I haven't had a chance to pay much attention to what's going on in West Oakland. I can tell you that I've noticed the commotion at the train station when the delayed train leaves, and I've seen the regulars debating the A's game at the diner, but that's about it.

sources.name: Claire Ashford
sources.quote: To be honest, I haven't really noticed much of a change around here on Piedmont Ave, but I've heard that West Oakland is getting more crowded. I mean, I checked the Civis Systems Field livestream the other day and it looked like they were making some progress, but that's about it. I don't really know what's going on over there.

sources.name: Deacon Seymour
sources.quote: I've seen a lot of new faces around West Oakland lately. As a manager for the A's and living near Lake Merritt, I notice the changes in the neighborhood. It's not just the numbers that are moving in; it's the vibe. People are excited, and there's a buzz. I've had to wait longer for tables at brunch spots because out-of-town friends want to try them out. It's a different feel, but I'm not sure if it's entirely comfortable yet.

approvedQuotes.text: To be honest, I don't know much about the changing demographics in West Oakland. I've been focused on my own neighborhood, Rockridge, and my family. I've been dealing with my own recovery and getting back to my routine after my accident. I haven't had a chance to pay much attention to what's going on in West Oakland. I can tell you that I've noticed the commotion at the train station when the delayed train leaves, and I've seen the regulars debating the A's game at the diner, but that's about it.

To be honest, I haven't really noticed much of a change around here on Piedmont Ave, but I've heard that West Oakland is getting more crowded. I mean, I checked the Civis Systems Field livestream the other day and it looked like they were making some progress, but that's about it. I don't really know what's going on over there.

I've seen a lot of new faces around West Oakland lately. As a manager for the A's and living near Lake Merritt, I notice the changes in the neighborhood. It's not just the numbers that are moving in; it's the vibe. People are excited, and there's a buzz. I've had to wait longer for tables at brunch spots because out-of-town friends want to try them out. It's a different feel, but I'm not sure if it's entirely comfortable yet.
